company.name: Elevision
company.shortDescription: Elevision is an advertising agency that specializes in screen installation, network activation, campaign creation, and other fields.
company.description: Elevision is an innovative Digital Media Network broadcasting news, information & advertisements inside the lifts of the UAE’s premier commercial and residential towers. They solve two problems; the need for advertisers to locate and reach consumers; and the need for property owners to effectively communicate with tenants. They deliver media to an affluent audience in a captive environment throughout their day.

Elevision, a leading digital-out-of-home (DOOH) media company in the UAE and UK, has announced a new partnership with VIOOH, a global DOOH supply-side platform. The partnership enables programmatic access to Elevision's screen inventory via multiple demand-side platforms, expanding programmatic buying opportunities for advertisers in both the UAE and UK.
